exposure.title: The admin console may be open to the internet
exposure.advice: This machine has a public address (203.1.113.5) and RCON listens on port 25575 on every interface - Minecraft cannot bind it separately from the game. No firewall was found. RCON is unencrypted and guarded only by its password. Block it: sudo ufw allow OpenSSH && sudo ufw allow 25565/tcp && sudo ufw enable (allow SSH first, or enabling the firewall will lock you out).
